fraud.text:
(a) To the best of our knowledge and according to the information and explanations given to us, no fraud by the Company or no material fraud on the Company has been noticed or reported during the period covered by our audit. 

(b) According to the information and explanations given to us including the representation made to us by the management of the Company, no report under sub-section 12 of section 143 of the Act has been filed by the auditors in Form ADT-4 as prescribed under Rule 13 of Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014, with the Central Government for the period covered by our audit. 

(c) The whistle blower complaints received by the Company during the year, as shared with us by the management have been considered by us while determining the nature, timing and extent of audit procedures.

operating_notes.text: Automotive Technologies, Vehicle Lifetime Solutions, and Exports delivered robust double-digit growth in Q1 CY26.
Q1 YoY double digit growth momentum sustained in Automotive Technologies, Vehicle Lifetime Solutions and Exports.
Localization levels reached 80% in Q1 CY26.
Schaeffler India opened computational research infrastructure at FSID, Bengaluru and signed an MRA with IISC.
Exports grew 24% YoY in Q2 CY26, driven mainly by intercompany allocations leveraging India capacity, mainly at Savli.
Bearings and Industrial Solutions recorded its highest-value business wins in the quarter, across cylindrical roller bearings, DGBBs, spherical rollers and TRBs.
CY26 capex of ₹500 Cr split: ₹170 Cr in automotive technologies, remainder in B&IS; sustaining capex about 10% of total.
Localisation is about 80% overall, 90% in automotive and 65-70% in industrial; e-axle is at Phase 2 of localisation with 100% import of kits.
Railways is about 13-14% of revenue, helped by 100% locally made insulation-coated bearings for electric locomotives.
Wind: 1.6-metre bearing for 6 MW turbines produced last quarter; Savli Hall 3 construction started for the wind segment.
Double-digit growth momentum observed across both domestic and export businesses.
Received GST demand order from CGST & Central Excise Indore for FY21-FY24 involving ₹13.85 Cr penalty.
Q3CY26 standalone revenue grew 27.4% YoY to ₹3,005.8 Cr with an EBITDA margin of 18.7%.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,585.64 Cr (+18.9% YoY), net profit ₹316.07 Cr (+25.6% YoY).
Schaeffler India reported Q1 CY26 revenue of ₹2,507 Cr (+18.8% YoY) and net profit of ₹319.7 Cr.
Schaeffler India Limited’s 63rd AGM on April 30, 2026, passed all resolutions with Ashish Tiwari (VP - Legal & Company Secretary) confirming 100% approval for cost auditor remuneration via e-voting.
Schaeffler India reported Q1 CY26 standalone revenue of ₹2,507 Cr (+18.8% YoY) and PAT of ₹319.7 Cr (+12.8% YoY).
On 13 May 2026, Schaeffler India announced the opening of computational research infrastructure at FSID, Bengaluru, and signed an MRA with IISC.
Schaeffler India's Q2 CY26 call reported standalone revenue of ₹2,681 Cr (+17.5% YoY) and PAT of ₹337 Cr, with consolidated revenue of ₹2,760 Cr at 18.5% EBITDA margin.
On 28 September 2026 Schaeffler India's management told investors FY27 revenue would cross ₹10,000 Cr, with exports guided to stay at 15-20% of sales and localisation at about 80%.
2026-10-19: Schaeffler India CEO Harsha Gopal Kadam taken into custody by Talegaon MIDC Police in connection with June 2026 factory accident investigation
On October 23, 2026, Schaeffler India updated that CEO Harsha Kadam was released on bail after non-bailable charges were dropped, and the Bombay High Court stayed further investigation.
Schaeffler India reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹3,005.8 Cr, up 27.4% year-over-year.
Schaeffler India received a GST demand and penalty order of ₹13.85 Cr for FY 2020-21 to 2023-24 and is filing an appeal.
Schaeffler India reported Q3CY26 standalone revenue of ₹3,005.8 Cr, up 27.4% YoY, with an EBITDA margin of 18.7%.
Audio recording of Analyst/Investor meet held on 29 Oct 2026 is available on the company's website.
